theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start your investment journey with just ₹500
body: Small amounts invested regularly can build substantial wealth over time. Time is your greatest advantage as a young investor.
caption: Beginning early with modest sums allows you to benefit from consistent investing habits and long-term compounding. Every rupee counts when you start young. #YoungInvestor #SmallStepsMonthly #InvestEarly #WealthBuilding #StartNow
